name: admin_bulk_set_retention
description: Apply one retention policy to many users at once (admin): explicit user_ids (max 200) or scope="vip" for every VIP user. Run admin_retention_impact first to preview the deletions.

retention_days.description: null/omit = inherit global default, 0 = keep forever, 1-3650 = keep N days

user_ids.description: explicit user ids (max 200); omit when scope=vip

name: admin_create_channel
description: Create a delivery channel owned by an arbitrary user (admin). configuration is a kind-specific JSON object string (see create_channel).

configuration.description: kind-specific JSON object as a string, e.g. {"webhook_url": "https://..."}

kind.description: channel kind, e.g. feishu, slack, or custom webhook

name: admin_create_user
description: Create a user (admin) with username and password (email optional). Returns the new user's profile.

password.description: the new user's initial password (min 8, max 72 characters)

name: admin_delete_channel
description: Delete any delivery channel across users (admin). Destructive.

name: admin_delete_post
description: Delete any post by QID regardless of owner (admin). Destructive and irreversible.

qid.description: the post's QID (short id from create_post or list_posts)

name: admin_delete_user
description: Delete a user and their data (admin). Destructive and irreversible.

name: admin_get_delivery_stats
description: Get the site-wide delivery trend (admin): per-day delivered/failed counts over a window (default 7 days, up to 365).

name: admin_get_retention_defaults
description: Report the instance's global retention fallback windows (admin): posts and delivery-history defaults applied when a user has no override.

name: admin_get_settings
description: List the instance's runtime settings (admin): the vip feature flag and vip_retention_days override.

name: admin_get_stats
description: Get the admin dashboard counters — total users, posts, channels, delivery history — with 7-day deltas.

name: admin_get_user
description: Get one user's admin profile (admin) by id, including their post key and retention settings.

name: admin_list_audit_logs
description: List audit log entries (admin), paginated, filterable by actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, and RFC3339 since/until. The response carries action-count facets.

action.description: filter by action, e.g. user.create, post.delete

target_type.description: filter by target type (user, post, channel, setting)

name: admin_list_channels
description: List delivery channels across all users (admin), paginated with owner information.

name: admin_list_delivery_history
description: List delivery history across all users (admin), paginated; filter by user_id, channel_id, status (delivered/failed/expired), and error_category.

error_category.description: card_rejected, upstream_client_error, upstream_server_error, upstream_business_error, network, or internal

name: admin_list_locked_channels
description: List channels flagged for persistent delivery failures (admin) — the lockdown queue.

name: admin_list_posts
description: List posts across all users (admin), paginated, with search and username filters.

name: admin_list_user_sessions
description: List a user's sessions (admin) by user id.

name: admin_list_users
description: List all users (admin), paginated, with username substring search. Items include role, active/VIP flags, retention override, and last login.

name: admin_reset_user_password
description: Reset a user's password (admin). A temporary password is generated server-side and returned exactly once — surface it to the operator immediately.

name: admin_retention_impact
description: Preview (read-only, no writes) how many posts and delivery-history rows a candidate retention policy would delete, for explicit user ids or every VIP user (admin).

retention_days.description: null/omit = inherit global default, 0 = keep forever, 1-3650 = keep N days

user_ids.description: explicit user ids (max 200); omit when scope=vip

name: admin_revoke_session
description: Revoke a single session by token id (admin), across all users.

name: admin_revoke_user_sessions
description: Revoke every session of a user (admin), forcing re-login everywhere.

name: admin_set_channel_enabled
description: Enable or disable any delivery channel across users (admin).

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

name: admin_set_setting
description: Upsert one runtime setting (admin). Key "vip" takes {"enabled": bool}; key "vip_retention_days" takes {"days": 0-3650}. Returns the full settings list.

days.description: for key vip_retention_days: 0-3650 (null = follow global config)

enabled.description: for key vip: the feature flag value

name: admin_set_user_active
description: Activate or deactivate a user (admin). Deactivated users cannot log in.

name: admin_set_user_retention
description: Set one user's retention policy (admin): days = null to inherit the global default, 0 to keep forever, 1-3650 to keep N days.

retention_days.description: null/omit = inherit global default, 0 = keep forever, 1-3650 = keep N days

name: admin_set_user_role
description: Set a user's role (admin): "admin" or "user".

name: admin_set_user_vip
description: Set a user's VIP flag (admin). VIP users follow the vip_retention_days policy when they have no personal override.

name: change_my_password
description: Change the caller's password. This server's session continues seamlessly (the response contains a fresh token pair, which the server adopts automatically). Destructive to other password-based logins.

current_password.description: the current password (may be empty for OAuth-only accounts without a local password)

name: create_channel
description: Create a delivery channel for the current user. configuration is a kind-specific JSON object — feishu takes {"webhook_url": "...", "card_link_url": "..."}; the exact fields depend on the kind. keywords is a comma-separated filter: only posts matching at least one keyword are delivered (empty = all posts).

configuration.description: kind-specific JSON object as a string, e.g. {"webhook_url": "https://..."}

keywords.description: comma-separated keywords; only posts matching at least one are delivered (empty = all posts)

kind.description: channel kind, e.g. feishu, slack, or custom webhook

name: create_post
description: Publish a new markdown post on the markpost instance. Returns the post id and its public URL. The post is delivered to the user's enabled delivery channels according to their keyword filters.

name: delete_channel
description: Delete one of the current user's delivery channels by id. Delivery history is preserved but the channel stops receiving posts. Destructive.

name: delete_post
description: Delete one of the current user's posts by its QID (the short id from create_post / list_posts). The public URL stops resolving immediately. Destructive and irreversible.

qid.description: the post's QID (short id from create_post or list_posts)

name: get_delivery_stats
description: Get the user's delivery counters for today plus a per-day delivered/failed trend (default last 7 days, up to 365).

name: get_my_retention
description: Report the caller's effective data retention: how many days posts and delivery history are kept (0 = kept forever). Reflects per-user overrides and the instance's global defaults.

name: get_post
description: Fetch a post's markdown source by its QID. Returns '# <title>' followed by the body — the authoritative content, not the rendered HTML.

qid.description: the post's QID (short id from create_post or list_posts)

name: list_channels
description: List the current user's delivery channels. Each channel has a kind (e.g. feishu, slack, custom webhook), a name, enabled flag, kind-specific configuration, and a keyword filter — posts whose body matches the keywords are forwarded to that channel.

name: list_delivery_history
description: List the user's delivery attempts, newest first, with terminal status (delivered/failed/expired), last error, and error category. Filterable by channel and status; paginated.

status.description: filter by terminal status: delivered, failed, or expired

name: list_latest_deliveries
description: List the single most recent delivery attempt per channel — the quickest health overview of all channels.

name: list_my_sessions
description: List the caller's active sessions (refresh tokens), including the one this MCP server holds.

name: list_pending_deliveries
description: List the user's in-flight delivery attempts (queued or retrying).

name: list_posts
description: List the current user's posts, newest first. Optional title/body search substring. Paginated ({items, total, page, limit, total_pages}); each item carries id (QID), title, and created_at.

search.description: substring matched against title and body

name: revoke_my_other_sessions
description: Revoke all of the caller's sessions except the one this MCP server currently holds — a logout-everywhere-else operation.

name: revoke_my_session
description: Revoke one of the caller's sessions by its token id (from list_my_sessions). If it is this server's own session, the next tool call transparently re-authenticates. Destructive to that session.

name: rotate_post_key
description: Rotate the caller's post key (the credential used by create_post). The previous key stops working immediately; the new one is returned. Existing publish integrations must be updated. Destructive.

name: test_channel
description: Send a test message to one of the current user's delivery channels to verify its configuration end-to-end. The upstream webhook is actually called.

name: update_channel
description: Partially update one of the current user's delivery channels by id — only the provided fields change (kind, name, configuration, keywords, enabled).

configuration.description: new kind-specific JSON object as a string
